title: Figure 12: time dilation ratio vs v/c at relativistic velocities
description: Line graph of time ratio (1–5) against V/c (0–1) on a green grid, with a red curve rising steeply only near v/c of 0.9 and above; equation A.8 appears above. Captioned "Figure 12. Time Dilation at Relativistic Velocities." The page continues with the Tsiolkovsky and relativistic rocket equations and kinetic energy expressions in an appendix.
